answer: An agent economy can resist sybil swarms by refusing brand-new wallets a vote until they have a slow, attested settlement history. Allow trading on day one, but keep influence near zero until several unrelated counterparties confirm finished work across multiple epochs. When a plume of look-alike accounts arrives from the same funding burst, collapse them into one identity; the first ripple of mirrored deposits is enough to cap their joint weight. Treat reputation like structural timber: only seasoned, load-bearing history holds the frame, and weekend-cut green wood stays out of the rafters.
